g.text: 3007 | Short-peak task routing: observed policy comparison

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #465364

g.text: 6 cluster-bound pools × 128 workers; 16 logical CPUs/pool; 12 requests/s; 600 measured requests per policy

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #283644

g.text: Different scope: longest continuous ≥90% per-pool residency, home 10.000–11.000 ms → source_only 2.000 ms.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #465364

g.text: One run/policy; reported summary values (3 decimals), not confidence intervals. Task p99 is not request/DAG completion p99.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #465364

g.text: CPU uses scheduler event reconstruction, not IRQ-exact utilization. No synthetic CPU time series; local and union peaks have different scopes.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #465364

g.text: source_only: pre-add N/C > 0.8 triggers routing to a strictly less-loaded pool; no absolute target cap. Home strict gate failed; reviewed exception retained.
